court_name: HIGH COURT OF ANDHRA PRADESH AT AMARAVATI
raw_summary: The High Court dismissed the criminal appeal filed by the appellant, confirming his conviction and sentence for offenses including kidnapping, rape, and murder of a minor girl. The court found the prosecution proved the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt, relying on circumstantial evidence such as the appellant being the last person seen with the victim and the nature of the injuries on the deceased. The appeal challenged the judgment dated 26.07.2018 passed by the learned Sessions Judge.
